metadata.title: GeoAlgeria wilaya telephone area code provenance
metadata.description: Why each of the eleven wilayas Law 26-06 created (codes 59 to 69) carries the phone_code it carries. A value appears here only with an official citation; a null carries a reason naming the official texts searched and what each one said. The codes wilayas 1 to 58 carry predate this ledger and are not restated by it.
metadata.rule: A code is taken from an official text only: the Journal Officiel, an ARPCE decision or published numbering plan, or an Algerie Telecom announcement. It is never derived from the mother wilaya, and never taken from an encyclopaedia, directory or press listing.

sources.name: ARPCE: Numbering. The ten-digit plan national de numerotation adopted 22 February 2008, format ZABPQMCDU, where ZA is the geographic zone; numbering resources are allocated by the Authority under article 13 of Law 18-04
ARPT: Nouveau plan de numerotation telephonique pour l'Algerie (PDF, document dated 24 December 2007)
Algerie Telecom: Les Nouvelles numerotations, the operator's own notice archive for number changes
Journal Officiel n° 25, 5 April 2026 (Law 26-06), the text that creates wilayas 59 to 69
Journal Officiel n° 40, 3 June 2026 (Presidential decree 26-206 of 25 May 2026), the codes and seats of wilayas 59 to 69
Journal Officiel n° 52, 21 July 2026 (Executive decree 26-253 of 15 July 2026), the daira annex for the new wilayas

no-official-allocation.statement: No official text allocates a telephone area code to this wilaya. ARPCE allocates numbering resources under the ten-digit plan national de numerotation of 22 February 2008, whose geographic digits identify a numbering zone rather than a wilaya, and the Authority has published no allocation for the 2026 cohort. The three texts that create and organise these wilayas are silent on numbering. Algerie Telecom has announced no new area code for them. The code the mother wilaya carries is not evidence for the new one and is deliberately not copied here.

searched.looked_for: a text on the plan national de numerotation or on telephone indicatifs, and any numbering article in the three texts that create and organise wilayas 59 to 69
searched.result: No Journal officiel text on telephone numbering was found. JORA n° 25 (2026), Law 26-06 creates the eleven wilayas; JORA n° 40 (2026), decree 26-206 art. 1 fixes each one's code and seat; JORA n° 52 (2026), decree 26-253, annexe fixes their dairas. All three are silent on telephone numbering.

searched.looked_for: the published numbering plan and any decision allocating area codes to the wilayas created in 2019 or in 2026
searched.result: The numbering page describes the ten-digit plan of 22 February 2008 and the ZABPQMCDU format whose ZA digits are a geographic zone. It publishes no wilaya-to-code table and addresses neither cohort of new wilayas. The 2007 plan document allocates 02, 03 and 04 to Algerie Telecom and leaves 01 unallocated, with no per-wilaya assignment. No ARPCE decision allocating a code to a new wilaya was found.

searched.looked_for: an operator announcement of new area codes for the new wilayas
searched.result: The operator's numbering notices concern local number changes in named communes after infrastructure upgrades. No announcement of an area code for any wilaya of the 2026 cohort was found.

no-official-allocation.note: A silence is not a negative. This records what was searched on 2026-10-01 and what it said; an official allocation published later replaces the null with the cited value.

metadata.note: Wilayas 1 to 58 are out of this ledger's scope. Their phone_code values predate it and no official citation has been established for them yet; see ROADMAP.md.
